sn35.110:1.1: upādāniye ca bhikkhave, dhamme desissāmi upādānañca.
sn35.110:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā? katamañca upādānaṃ?
sn35.110:1.5: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ, sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.110:1.6: jivhā upādāniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ. kāyo …pe…
sn35.110:1.8: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
sn35.110:1.9: ime vuccanti bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā, idaṃ upādānanti.
